items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: he’d give me any songs from “Pretzel Logic” Steely Dan, to Bishop Trotter and the Holy Spirits gospel music

ctx.x: Hold on one second. That was my fault are you still there? Okay we’ll just snip that out.

Yeah. So you know after college ended I kind of did have that big decision you know. I was in a position where I was playing enough shows to get by but it was a big grind and I kind of wanted to just set myself up for a little bit more of a future so that if I did want to go for it again I kind of had a little more stability in my life. Of course right when I got settled with that job I got the call. So it was definitely a sign and you know I’ve always had a very, I’ve always been pretty competitive kind of…
If either of you met someone who didn’t know what you did and then you tell them I play in a band and they say, “What kind of music do you play?” Do you have an answer for that?
